partner_results_applied.scope: law-level convex-mixture localization of arbitrary cap-one product laws by compact finite-fragment extreme product laws with total-variation control

new_result.name: graphical inverse-gap localization with exact cluster threshold
new_result.statement: For every fixed finite graph G with edge exponents theta_e, the product pair-gap moment is uniformly finite over all independent cap-one densities iff every vertex cluster S has internal exponent sum strictly less than |S|-1. The same bound is uniform under arbitrary deterministic separate shifts. Failure at any cluster gives logarithmic or power divergence already for iid Uniform[0,1].
new_result.proof_mechanism: near-edge expansion; connected-component factorization; ordered gaps; common-translation integral <=1; weighted Hall/max-flow allocation of exponents to gaps; weighted AM-GM; one-dimensional gap integration

target_level_partner_application: By account03/B14 convex-mixture localization, a bounded-size subcritical graph certificate may choose a different active block/graph/exponents for each extreme-product mixture component; uniform cluster slack and local coefficient then transfer to arbitrary supports with the same universal graph constant. No single physical triple is forced.
unresolved_implication: Derive in every unresolved heavy/localized branch a deterministic-outside shell/coarea estimate whose singular factor is a uniformly bounded-size shifted pair-gap graph with positive cluster slack, or show that the exact shell necessarily reaches a critical collision cluster.
next_step: Inspect a live heavy/localized shell identity before taking absolute values; identify its collision graph and exponent loads. If all cluster loads are uniformly subcritical, apply the new graph compiler plus partner convex-mixture localization.
